d:
A woman visits Gokuldham with magical mood stones claiming they reveal a man’s true love by changing color. When Jethalal's stone turns black, she accuses him of loving someone other than Daya, leaving Jethalal hurt and embarrassed before the society members.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
